chunks: It is He who has sent His Apostle with the guidance and the true faith, so that He may exalt it over every other creed. God is sufficient as a witness.

key_terms.لِيُظْهِرَهُ: So that He may exalt/make it dominant

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of sending the Prophet with guidance according to Surah Al-Fath?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tajalli al-Haqq* (Manifestation of Truth), emphasizing that the Prophet's mission culminates in the ultimate supremacy of Islam, a theme deeply connected to the Imamate as the continuation of divine guidance. The phrase 'wa kafa billahi shahida' underscores God's self-sufficiency as the ultimate witness, validating the authenticity of the message without need for human attestation. This declaration serves as a theological foundation for the eschatological victory of the Ahl al-Bayt and the establishment of divine justice.
